description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between Max Ambiguity and Fleiss Kappa, with two sets of bars presented side-by-side. The horizontal axis represents Max Ambiguity, labeled with categories 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94 for the first chart and 1, 2, and 3 for the second chart; the categories are not sorted in any apparent order. The vertical axis is labeled “Fleiss Kappa” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.9 with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The first chart contains four dark teal bars, with heights approximately corresponding to values of 0.88, 0.46, 0.24, and 0.03, respectively. The second chart contains three dark teal bars, with heights approximately corresponding to values of 0.89, 0.46, and 0.23, respectively. Each bar is labeled with its corresponding Fleiss Kappa value at the top. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
